newsitem.title: USA: FINAL PRICING -- Gulf Breeze, Fla..
newsitem.headline: FINAL PRICING -- Gulf Breeze, Fla..

text.p: THE COUPON ON THE SERIES 1997A MUNI EXEMPT CPI BONDS IS BASED ON THE ANNUALIZED PERCENTAGE CHANGE IN THE NON SEASONALLY ADJUSTED (URBAN) CPI INDEX PLUS THE SPREAD PER ANNUM, PAID AND CALCULATED ON A SEMI-ANNUAL BASIS.
PLEASE REFER TO PAGE 10 OF THE POS FOR A MORE DETAILED SUMMARY ON THE METHOD OF INTEREST RATE CALCULATION.
THE INITIAL (URBAN) CPI INDEX WILL BE 159.84516 THE INITIAL DATE IS 02/20/97.
ALL BONDS ARE PRICED AT PAR.
CALL FEATURES: NOT SUBJECT TO OPTIONAL REDEMPTION. REFER TO EXTRAORDINARY REDEMPTION FEATURE IN OS.
PLEASE SEE POS FOR MORE DETAILS REGARDING THE SERIES 1997A (MUNI EXEMPT CPI
The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply.
This issue is book entry. DTC is pending.
